row.team_price_text: Free (open source, self-hosted); hosted service shut down in 2021
row.evidence: Redash is a free open-source project (the hosted app.redash.io service shut down on November 30, 2021); its docs offer SAML 2.0 and Google login with Just-in-Time user creation, and no SCIM endpoint is documented.
row.notes: Redash is open source and self-hosted only: Databricks shut down hosted Redash on November 30, 2021 and points users to Databricks SQL or self-hosted OSS ('host for yourself free of charge'). redash.io/pricing redirects to the home page, so the home page is the pricing evidence. SAML 2.0 (any IdP via pysaml) and Google OAuth are built in, with JIT user creation and SAML-driven group membership via the RedashGroups attribute; no SCIM and no automated deprovisioning. The REST API is documented only partially (queries, dashboards, results) with no user endpoints. 'None' is by absence (rule 5).

plans.name: Open source (self-hosted)
plans.notes: No paid plans; the hosted service ended in 2021. scim false by absence.

scim.notes: No SCIM endpoint in the Redash knowledge base (user guide, admin guide, API page). Users come from invitations, password sign-up, or JIT on SAML / Google login. 'false' is by absence (rule 5).

user_api.notes: Redash has a REST API (user and query API keys) and its FAQ says everything in the UI is available through it, but the published endpoint list (queries, jobs, query results, dashboards) is explicitly incomplete and documents no user, group or role endpoints.

okta.notes: No Okta OIN listing found (okta.com/integrations/redash/ returns 404); Redash's guide sets up a custom SAML web app.

entra.notes: No Microsoft Learn tutorial found (redash-tutorial returns 404).

google.notes: Google Login (OAuth) with an allowed Google Apps domain list; not a Workspace catalogue SAML app.

onelogin.notes: Redash's docs mention OneLogin's predefined Redash application (SAML, passes RedashGroups).

fallbacks.notes: JIT on first SAML or Google OAuth sign-in. The SAML RedashGroups attribute sets group membership on every login (OneLogin's app always sends it). No automated deprovisioning documented.
